_comment: Panel rules for Patreon episodes the feed credits to nobody. Checked in as data so a
wrong entry is fixed by editing one line rather than by changing a parser.
sagaVolumes: Saga of Saga hosts are per VOLUME, not per issue, and each volume covers six
issues — issue N belongs to volume ceil(N/6). Host1+Host2 recorded the issue episodes; the
third name in Mike's prep doc is the volume WRAP person, which is why including it kept
over-crediting. Validated against all 15 Saga descriptions that name anyone: 14 exact, 1
seriesPanels: runs with a standing panel. `unlessDescriptionNames` means the description
wins whenever it names a roster member, so a stand-in is picked up automatically.
fromPublicEpisode: Patreon companions to a public episode inherit that episode's panel.
A volume wrap adds the doc's Summary-column name to that volume's two hosts, or runs
with all four when the doc says 'Everyone'. Verified against every wrap description that
names anyone: volumes 3,4,5,6,7,8 match Host1+Host2+Summary exactly. Volume 2's doc row
says 'Everyone' but its description names three, so a description always wins here.

sagaVolumeEpisodes._comment: Volumes 10-12 have no per-issue episodes. Read from the speaker labels under their own headings in Mike's prep doc; Volume 11 agrees exactly with its episode description.

seriesPanels.why: standing panel; at least one episode has Kara Szamborski in for Brian Murray
Paul Jaissle hosts every episode; co-hosts are named in the description

publicCounterpart._comment: Not Patreon-exclusive. The two feeds number minisodes differently, so these join on the content half of the title, never the number.
publicCounterpart.Minisode 61 | Ice Cream Man Vol. 8: Minisode 61 | Ice Cream Man Volume 8: Subjects & Objects

hold._comment: Titles whose proposal is known wrong. They ship with no panel rather than a guessed one, and are the first candidates for a `Panel:` line in the Patreon post.
hold.IRCB's Best of 2022: the description lists whose picks were discussed, not who recorded — it names all ten regulars
